title: How to automate SMB credit decisioning without increasing defaults
summary: Learn how commercial lenders automate small business loan decisioning with multi-signal scorecards, automated verification gates, and dynamic limit sizing.
body_markdown:
### What is straight-through processing (STP) in commercial lending?


Straight-through processing (STP) means a defined process finishes without manual intervention. In lending, specify whether you mean verification, a credit decision, or the full application-to-funding process. Also distinguish automated approvals from automated declines when reporting the rate.


### How do automated decision engines detect overleveraged borrowers?


Bank transactions may reveal recurring payments not listed on the application. Confirm what those payments are and compare all obligations with cash available for repayment. A payment pattern alone does not prove a merchant cash advance, which is funding repaid from future business receipts, or establish the full balance owed.


### What auto-approval rate should a commercial lender target?


Set a target for your product and borrower population, not a universal percentage. Define the denominator and whether the rate includes declines or only approvals. Evaluate speed and review workload alongside repayment outcomes and decision quality before raising the target.


### What should happen when a required data source is unavailable?


Keep unavailable data separate from a passed check. Retry, request other evidence, or route the application for review according to policy. Record the missing input so the lender can distinguish a source failure from a borrower risk finding.
